ArgonTest.Name: Read file
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::* import Argon.IO::*
proc main(): () do let path = Path.from_string "input.bin" puts path.display
let resource = path.open_read let stream = resource.resource let data = Array.newFilled 7 42u8 if data.length >= 7 then let count = stream.read data 1 5 puts (count.to_s()) puts (data[0].to_s()) puts (data[1].to_s()) puts (data[2].to_s()) puts (data[3].to_s()) puts (data[4].to_s()) puts (data[5].to_s()) puts (data[6].to_s()) let eof_count = stream.read data 0 1 puts (eof_count.to_s()) end resource.close () end
